recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key photograph of a male performer on a dark stage, illuminated by a single, dramatic blue-tinted spotlight from the upper right. The performer is captured in a soulful, introspective pose, with the lower half of the frame featuring warm, amber stage lighting reflecting off a surface. The typography is left-aligned in the upper quadrant, using heavy, wide slab-serif letterforms.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the top-right spotlight and the bottom-left performer.
Color contrast between the cool blue beam and the warm amber stage glow.
Textual weight balanced against the vast negative space of the dark background.
coreInvariants: Deep black background with minimal detail.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Performer positioned in the lower-center, occupying approximately one-quarter of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright blue spotlight source in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-right light source, follows the beam down to the performer, then moves left to the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space creates a sense of intimacy and focus.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Amber/Gold (Stage reflection and middle text line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the concentrated light beams.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif with heavy horizontal strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family with color variation to denote hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin-lined rectangular border for metadata in top right
Small logo-like emblem in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic and historical period.
Captures the wide, mid-century modern geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dark stage scene with a man in a suit singing into a microphone. A sharp blue spotlight shines from the top right corner onto him. Warm amber light reflects off the floor boards at his feet. The rest of the image is pitch black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of left-aligned text in the top left. Use an extra-wide, heavy slab-serif font. The first and third lines should be white; the middle line should be golden amber. Add a small boxed metadata label in the top right near the light source.

verificationChecks: Is the spotlight beam clearly visible and blue-tinted?
Is the text extra-wide and slab-serif?
Is the background predominantly solid black?
Is the middle line of text a different color than the others?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between light and shadow.
Ensure the blue beam originates from a distinct point source.
Confirm the typography is left-aligned and horizontally extended.
Verify the color palette is limited to black, white, blue, and amber.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key stage portrait with a single diagonal cool-toned light beam and heavy, wide slab-serif typography placed in the dark negative space.
